title: 迷失的目标
excerpt: 体系的复杂化，催生普遍的目标迷失与工具异化。本应服务人类发展的制度流程，最终绑架了所有人，让无数人困在无意义的形式内耗之中
excerpt_en: The complexity of systems inevitably leads to widespread goal loss and tool alienation. Systems that should serve human development ultimately enslave everyone, trapping countless individuals in meaningless formalistic consumption.
